_note: The Croatian tax has two halves: one from CO2, which is a published table, and one from the price — but the price is the Croatian list price of the equivalent NEW car, filed with customs by the manufacturers and published nowhere. Their own FAQ says it outright: “Neovisno gdje je rabljeno motorno vozilo kupljeno i koliko je za njega plaćeno, Carinska uprava će u svim slučajevima utvrđivati tržišnu vrijednost rabljenog motornog vozila na hrvatskom tržištu.” So the amount is never in the total; the note names the half we can see. Both halves are computed as for a new car and then multiplied by the residual-value percentage of the Pravilnik's table 1.
